title: The inverse problem for the Steiner-Wiener index of trees
summary: For a connected graph $G$ and a set $S\subset V(G)$, the Steiner distance $d_G(S)$ is the minimum number of edges in a connected subgraph of $G$ containing $S$. The Steiner-Wiener $k$ index is defined by $\mathrm{SW}_k(G) = \sum_{S\subset V(G), |S|=k} d_G(S)$. We study the inverse problem for this invariant restricted to trees: for fixed $k$, which positive integers occur as $\mathrm{SW}_k(T)$ for a finite tree $T$?
